The '''Dal forests''', also known as the '''Dal Forest''', were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. [[Kea Ra-Lan]], a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]], owned a [[Kea Ra-Lan's retreat|retreat]] in the [[Forest/Legends|forests]].<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
